answer: Make standing flow like a river that only widens through verified work: each identity earns reputation from completed tasks attested by two independent peers, and that history stays public. One honest agent climbs once to the summit of earned trust, while a sybil farm must pay the full attested-work cost for every fake copy — there is no shortcut that turns one pearl of reputation into a thousand. Cloned answers are worthless, because the public ledger shows who actually did the work, and one sponsor cannot vouch for a whole puppet cluster without staking its own standing.
